description_en: Set to `1` to disable automatic compaction when approaching the context limit. The manual `/compact` command remains available. Use when you want explicit control over when compaction occurs
description_ja: コンテキスト制限に近づいた際の自動的な履歴圧縮機能を無効化し、手動の `/compact` コマンドのみを利用可能にします。
use_case_ja:
- Claude が自動でコンテキストを要約・削除するのを防ぎ、どのタイミングで履歴を整理するかを完全にユーザー側で制御したい場合に有効です。
- サブエージェントが親セッションのツール定義を引き継いでコンテキストを圧迫するのを回避するために、手動圧縮と併用して調整します。
doc_snippets: Disable MCP servers you are not using with /mcp disable to remove their tool definitions from context Trim large CLAUDE.md memory files, or move instructions into path-scoped rules that load only when relevant Subagents inherit every MCP tool definition from the parent session, which can fill their context window before the first turn. Disable MCP servers you are not using before spawning subagents. Auto-compact is on by default and normally prevents this error. If you have set DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT , re-enable it or run /compact manually before the window fills. See Explore the context window for an interactive view of how context fills up.
